integrity: The proof linearizes the published exact characterization equation, separates scalar and traceless symmetric-matrix modes, and uses the exact spherical fourth-moment tensor identity. A numerical two-dimensional Gaussian check was used only as a stress test, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is first-order and restricted to origin-centered ellipsoidal degree-two perturbations of \(RB_2^n\).
At the Gaussian critical radius \(R=\sqrt{n+p}\), no second-order or higher-order anisotropic term is determined.
A differently indexed perturbative observation remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Gaussian anisotropy reversal for dual \(L_p\) John ellipsoids
